steps.name: Set up job
Run actions/checkout@v4
Public bootstrap with private Node and pinned producer repositories
Verify managed setup without system Node or npm
Import pinned profiles without another checkout or system npm
Verify actual installed SDK, Dispatch, RAG and MCP contracts
Verify real installed update, refusal and archive lifecycle
Start and verify the owned CI sandbox engine
Build pinned local sandbox image and verify installed Workcell
Run actions/upload-artifact@v4
Post Run actions/checkout@v4
Complete job
